notes.title: Patch v0.3
notes.notes:
- Added a Tutorial at the beginning of the game
- Added new dialogs for many NPC's
- Added new quest for many NPC's 
- Added audio for some assets

- Changed many dialogs in the game to better fit the tutorial and prologue
- Updated quest system with markers to better guide the player


- Fixes Typos on many dialogs
- Fixed many minor bugs

- Minor improvement in performance

notes.title: Patch v0.2
notes.notes:
- Added a prologue to the beginning of the game
- Added new Trials to the main story
- Added new quest for the village NPC's
- Added audio for some assets

- Changed how combat works to be more intuitive

- Fixes Typos on many dialogs
- Fixed save and load game related bugs
- Fixed how the ingame ESC menu behaves in WideScreen monitors
- Fixed many minor bugs

notes.title: Emergency Patch 0.101
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where the game would not save properly upon the player collapses from exhaustion
- Fixed a bug when falling from exhaustion the camera would rapidly move towards the player spawn location
